messages:
sam-partnerships: Quick sync request 1 Aurora Systems shipped their compact A1 board. They want a short, reproducible perf doc + marketplace callout. Can we run a tight smoke + full matrix?
jamie-ops: we can do it. need firmware image, rack isolation, and a 48h quiet-window. prefer nights UTC.
tori-eng: what model targets? smallest models for edge workloads or our standard 13B/7B?
aurora-hw: hi all! thanks. target is our "A1-Edge" 7B int8 and 13B int8 + both fp16 variants for baseline. emphasize perf/W and sustained throughput at seq=512.
nate-ml: add quality checks: 40 prompt eval, embed-approx similarity > 0.95 for generation parity. we'll run rouge/bertscore too.
sam-partnerships: deliverables: 1) reproducible scripts + csvs in public repo 2) short how-to appendix on kernel flags 3) joint short blog and 10s demo clip. timeline?
maria-marketing: marketing prefers co-publish week of May 10 to tie with marketplace listing. legal needs 7 business days for copy review.
benchbot: scheduled-run created: run id 2026-04-aurora-01 window 2026-05-05T00:00:00Z..2026-05-05T06:00:00Z. harness: rwinfer-2.4.0.
jamie-ops: reserving rack aurora-rack-07, will pin to dedicated pool and enable per-card power telemetry. please upload checksum for firmware.
auroa-handoff: (aurora-hw) firmware uploaded to s3://aurora-shared/a1_v0.9.bin sha256: f1a2b3c4d5e6f7890abc1234def56789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789
tori-eng: thanks. test matrix suggestion: seq_lens=[64,256,512], batches auto-tuned, prefix_cache ON/OFF, kernel flags toggled: 
```
FORCE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1
REDUCE_L2_COPIES=1
KV_PREFETCH=1
```
nate-ml: include power sampling at 0.5s granularity if possible. we want smooth power curves for perf/W charts.
jamie-ops: 0.5s adds load to telemetry stack but ok for a dedicated run. we'll enable 0.5s for GPU power, ambient temp, and fan RPM.
benchbot: note: run queued -> pending infra reservation. run id 2026-04-aurora-01. will post start msg to channel.
maria-marketing: can we get 3 highlight numbers for the blog: best perf/W (int8), throughput at seq=512, and p99 latency at batch tuned? small visuals please.
aurora-hw: we'll provide thermal plate photos and a short note about airflow mounting for the blog visuals.
tori-eng: gating plan: 30 minute smoke on baseline config (fp16) -> 1 hour quality eval -> full matrix. abort if p99 > baseline * 2 or quality drops > 3% on bscore.
sam-partnerships: good gate. also legal requires the perf claim be worded as "Measured by Redwood Inference on Aurora A1 board using Redwood harness (see repo)". marie @legal to confirm.
maria-marketing: pinged legal. also request: please keep confidential numbers internal until the joint blog date.
jamie-ops: infra note: we'll collect raw power logs, kernel telemetry, and per-token timing. csv schema proposal: timestamp,run_id,model,bs,seq,tk_per_s,p95_ms,p99_ms,power_w,temp_c,fan_rpm,kflags.
nate-ml: include a random_seed and prompt_set_id in metadata so results are reproducible.
aurora-hw: can we include a short appendix titled "kernel tuning overview"? high-level statements only, no proprietary microcode.
tori-eng: yes we'll provide before/after percent deltas per-kernel. nothing low-level.
benchbot: infra reservation confirmed: aurora-rack-07 reserved for 2026-05-05T00:00Z-06:00Z. run scheduled.
sam-partnerships: action items: @aurora-hw upload firmware+spec by Apr 25; @tori-eng push harness config by Apr 28; @jamie-ops ensure rack reservations; @nate-ml prepare eval prompts; @maria-marketing draft copy.
jamie-ops: small ops ask 1 if marketplace listing happens, include the exact test command we run in repo (so partners can reproduce).
maria-marketing: absolutely, we'll link repo and include a short "how to reproduce" snippet.
aurora-hw: final: are we ok to include model size names in joint headlines? we'll avoid model-specific claims, per legal.
sam-partnerships: prefer neutral phrasing e.g., "Aurora A1 board achieves X perf/W on 7B-class models" and link to repo for full matrix. legal to finalize.
tori-eng: i'll post the harness json and run script tomorrow. smoke test targeted for Apr 29.
nate-ml: i'll post eval set and metrics script.
maria-marketing: thanks all. will slot draft for May 3 review.
sam-partnerships: great coordination team 1 will update when smoke is complete. :white_check_mark:
